data.name: Prithviposhan Pvt.Ltd
data.description: PrithviPoshan Private Limited is a Bengaluru, Karnataka-based company with 11-50 employees. It turns organic and agricultural waste into biochar for farmers and generates carbon credits from it. Its "PrithviPoshan Biochar Project" was open for public comment on the Verra registry until January 1, 2026, under the VM0044 methodology.
